_comment: Copy this to ~/.local/state/deckd/config.json and edit it, then restart deckd.
Every section is optional and validated on its own: a mistake in one
disables only the page it belongs to, and says so in the log.
The real file is mode 0600 because it holds your Spotify client id.
'deckd auth spotify --client-id <ID>' writes the spotify section for you.

weather._comment: A five-digit US ZIP code. Omit the section to turn the weather page off.

stocks._comment: Up to 8 symbols, one per key. Omit for a generic default watchlist.

_comment: Two teams, top row and bottom row. Both are required, or the page is off.
espnId is ESPN's own numeric team id. Find it in the URL of the team's
page on espn.com. league is 'nfl' or 'college-football'.
fullName must match ESPN's own name string exactly; it is how the
opponent is pulled out of 'Away Team at Home Team' without an extra
Optional companion display that sleeps with this Mac. Most likely
address first; the first one to answer is remembered. Omit the section
unless you have one - there is no default, and no heartbeat without it.
